attributes.name: card content anatomy
attributes.definition: Whether cards follow a structured, consistent set of component parts (thumbnail, badge, title, byline, excerpt) versus no defined anatomy.

values.definition: Cards consistently include a defined set of parts such as media, badge, title, meta and excerpt.
Cards have little defined structure or only one or two elements.
Statement does not address card anatomy.

attributes.name: card copy voice
attributes.definition: Tone and register of the text within cards.

values.definition: Casual voice with all-caps phrases, hashtags and emoji.
Journalistic or publication-style voice with titles, bylines and excerpts.

attributes.name: card typographic mix
attributes.definition: Use of distinct typefaces or styles within cards, such as serif body excerpts alongside bold sans titles.

values.definition: Bold titles combined with serif excerpt text.
